status.en: 20 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 233% more than the week before, most of them in Kigali, Kivu and Rugenge.
status.nb: 20 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 233 prosent flere enn uken før, flest i Kigali, Kivu og Rugenge.

summary.en: Joseph Kabila has formally allied with the M23 rebels, creating a coalition that is now attacking the Congolese army in North Kivu. Security personnel linked to Erik Prince were ambushed, resulting in the death of a former New Zealand special forces officer and the wounding of former UFC fighter Tim Kennedy. In Ituri, suspected ADF rebels killed 77 civilians. The conflict remains deadly, with 1,158 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Joseph Kabila har formelt alliert seg med M23-opprørerne, og danner en koalisjon som nå angriper den congolesiske hæren i Nord-Kivu. Sikkerhetspersonell knyttet til Erik Prince ble overfalt, noe som førte til at en tidligere New Zealand-spesialstyrkeoffiser døde og den tidligere UFC-utøveren Tim Kennedy ble såret. I Ituri drepte påståtte ADF-opprørere 77 sivile. Konflikten forblir dødelig, med 1 158 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: M23 campaign (2022–present)
background.extract: The M23 campaign is an ongoing series of military offensives launched by the March 23 Movement (M23), a Rwandan-backed rebel paramilitary group in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, since March 2022. In November 2021, M23 first launched attacks against the Congolese military (FARDC) and MONUSCO, seizing military positions in Ndiza, Cyanzu, and Runyoni in North Kivu Province. This coincided with the deployment of Uganda People's Defence Force (UPDF) to the region to combat the Allied Democratic Forces (ADF), a Ugandan rebel group operating in the Congo's North Kivu and Ituri provinces.
